summary: Work on image decoding focused on correctness and smoother loading. Firefox now supports fractional SVG viewports so SVGs scale more precisely, and image progress notifications are delivered per-observer to make incremental loading and cache behavior more efficient. The JPEG path was updated to use a new CMYK swizzle approach, improving color fidelity for CMYK JPEGs used in print and photography. A few small internal cleanups and default operator-equality changes were also applied (_mostly maintenance, no visible change_).
